system.description:
Relying on stillness and natural cover, you blur the lines of your form until watching eyes simply slide past you.

While no one is watching, and as long as you remain completely silent and unmoving in a shadowed place or behind cover, cross your arms before your chest to represent Obfuscate. While hidden, no one but a being using Auspex (or similar supernatural sensory acuity) can spot you. The concealment vanishes the instant you move, speak or interact with your environment in any way. Retest Stealth.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
